title: BONE PILE sits on top of the ground
root_cause: moves.js startPile used absolute world y 0.04-0.12 for bone targets; plaza FLOOR is 0.35 and targets are mesh origins, so bones sank 0.62-0.74 below the surface. floorAt was passed by main.js but dropped by setupMoves.
fix: floorAt-based target y + per-frame clampAboveGround (world bbox min.y >= ground + 0.012)

tests.test:bonepile: before FAIL -0.62/-0.74, after PASS +0.012 at 1366 and 412
